title: cmd delete deletes to the row end

known.thc-tui/real: terminal + thc: no ⌘Delete forward in thc_keys.lua (WezTerm sends CSI 3~), and thc binds nothing to ⌘Delete (editing_keys.rs ACTIONS lacks edit.delete_to_line_end)
known.thc-tui/headless: thc: ⌘Delete isn't bound (editing_keys.rs ACTIONS lacks caretline's edit.delete_to_line_end)
known.thc-screen/real: terminal: thc_keys.lua and fictty.lua both bind the ⌘ keys and WezTerm keeps the later (fictty's); thc screen on fictty da34390 doesn't set the `fictty` user var, so fictty's module re-sends every ⌘ key bare (⌘Z as `z`, ⌘← as ←). Passes on fictty 8670f90, which sets the var, or with thc_keys alone
